decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Numbers, Algebra and Quantitative Reasoning
decks.description: Arithmetic, symbolic manipulation and quantitative relationships supporting all five subjects.

outcomes.description: Solve equations, inequalities and elementary systems using equivalent transformations.
Compute with real and complex numbers, powers and scientific notation.
Reason with proportions, percentages, rates and unit conversions.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Chemical Matter, Atoms and Bonding
decks.description: Chemical representations, atomic structure and introductory bonding models.

outcomes.description: Relate isotopes, electron configurations and periodic trends to chemical behavior.
Use Lewis structures, molecular geometry, polarity and intermolecular-force models.
Interpret formulas and convert among mass, amount and particle number.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Programming Foundations
decks.description: Language-independent foundations for expressing and testing computations.

outcomes.description: Decompose programs into functions and modules with explicit contracts.
Trace and write programs using conditionals, iteration and recursion.
Represent values using primitive types, collections and structured records.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Functions, Coordinates and Trigonometry
decks.description: Functional representations and geometric tools needed before calculus.

outcomes.description: Translate geometric relationships among Cartesian, polar and parametric representations.
Analyze and compose polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic and inverse functions.
Use angular measure, trigonometric identities and sinusoidal models.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Logic, Sets and Proof
decks.description: The shared language of rigorous mathematics and theoretical computer science.

outcomes.description: Interpret propositions, predicates, quantifiers and logical equivalence.
Construct direct, contrapositive, contradiction and induction proofs.
Work with sets, relations, functions, equivalence classes and cardinality.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Biological Organization and Diversity
decks.description: Life's organizational levels, inheritance framework and major forms of diversity.

outcomes.description: Interpret major branches of life's diversity and shared biological characteristics.
Explain the relationships among genomes, reproduction, inheritance and phenotype.
Compare cellular organization, life cycles and biological levels of organization.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Chemical Reactions and Aqueous Solutions
decks.description: Stoichiometry, equilibrium, acids and bases, and oxidation-reduction.

outcomes.description: Solve introductory equilibrium, acid-base, buffer and solubility problems.
Assign oxidation states and balance and interpret redox reactions.
Balance reactions and calculate yields, concentrations and limiting reagents.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Digital Logic and Computer Organization
decks.description: The digital abstraction from logic circuits to processors and memory.

outcomes.description: Explain instruction sets, datapaths, control, pipelining and performance tradeoffs.
Construct combinational and sequential logic from Boolean specifications.
Analyze binary representations, caches, memory hierarchies and input-output mechanisms.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Programming Languages and Semantics
decks.description: Language meaning, type systems and computational abstractions.

outcomes.description: Compare functional, imperative, object-oriented and effectful programming abstractions.
Define operational semantics, evaluation strategies, binding and substitution.
Construct typing derivations and explain progress, preservation and polymorphism.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Combinatorics and Graph Theory
decks.description: Counting, discrete structures and recurrences with mathematical and computational applications.

outcomes.description: Apply bijections, inclusion-exclusion, generating functions and counting principles.
Analyze connectivity, trees, matchings, colorings and directed graphs.
Formulate and solve recurrences and bound discrete growth rates.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Linear Algebra
decks.description: Vector spaces, linear transformations and spectral structure.

outcomes.description: Use bases, coordinates, inner products and linear transformations.
Apply eigenvalues, diagonalization, orthogonal projections and singular-value decomposition.
Solve linear systems and interpret rank, nullity and determinants.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Single-Variable Calculus
decks.description: Limits, continuous change, accumulation and infinite expansions.

outcomes.description: Differentiate functions and model rates, extrema and local approximations.
Evaluate integrals and apply the fundamental theorem of calculus.
Evaluate limits and determine continuity and asymptotic behavior.
Analyze series convergence and construct power-series approximations.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Physical Measurement and Modeling
decks.description: Operational quantities, uncertainty and idealized physical models.

outcomes.description: Build idealized models and test limiting cases and physical consistency.
Distinguish precision, accuracy, systematic error and propagated measurement uncertainty.
Use dimensions, unit systems, scaling and dimensional analysis.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Inorganic Structure and Reactivity
decks.description: Main-group, coordination and extended inorganic chemical systems.

outcomes.description: Analyze coordination geometry, isomerism, ligand fields and complex stability.
Explain main-group structures and reactions through periodic and bonding trends.
Describe ionic and covalent solid structures and composition-structure relationships.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Organic Structure and Reactivity
decks.description: Carbon frameworks, stereochemistry and electronic determinants of reactivity.

outcomes.description: Explain acidity and stability using resonance, induction and solvation.
Identify nucleophiles, electrophiles and electron-flow patterns in organic transformations.
Represent functional groups, conformations, stereoisomers and aromatic systems.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Automata, Languages and Computability
decks.description: Formal computation models and the limits of algorithmic solvability.

outcomes.description: Construct finite automata and relate them to regular languages.
Analyze context-free grammars, pushdown automata and language hierarchies.
Use Turing machines and reductions to establish undecidability.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Data Structures
decks.description: Data organization, representation invariants and operation costs.

outcomes.description: Analyze time, space and amortized costs of data-structure operations.
Establish representation invariants and preserve them across operations.
Implement and select sequences, trees, hash tables, heaps and graph representations.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Systems Programming
decks.description: Programs at the boundary between language abstractions and machine resources.

outcomes.description: Identify races and coordinate shared-state programs using synchronization primitives.
Use calling conventions, linking, system calls and resource-lifetime contracts.
Reason about pointers, allocation, ownership, layout and memory errors.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Abstract Algebra
decks.description: Groups, rings and fields as organizing mathematical structures.

outcomes.description: Analyze field extensions and explain the basic Galois correspondence.
Analyze groups, homomorphisms, quotient groups and group actions.
Work with rings, ideals, quotient constructions and polynomial factorization.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Multivariable and Vector Calculus
decks.description: Differentiation and integration in higher-dimensional spaces.

outcomes.description: Compute gradients, Jacobians, Hessians and multivariable local approximations.
Evaluate multiple integrals using coordinate transformations and Jacobians.
Apply line and surface integrals, divergence, curl and integral theorems.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Real Analysis
decks.description: Rigorous foundations of limits, continuity and calculus.

outcomes.description: Establish differentiation and integration results with explicit hypotheses.
Use completeness, compactness and metric-space arguments in analysis.
Prove results about sequences, series and pointwise or uniform convergence.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Classical Mechanics
decks.description: Newtonian motion, conservation laws, rotation and elementary fluids.

outcomes.description: Apply energy, momentum and angular-momentum conservation to physical systems.
Model particle motion using forces, kinematics and Newton's laws.
Apply pressure, buoyancy, continuity and elementary ideal or viscous flow relations.
Analyze rigid-body rotation, torque, equilibrium and gravitational motion.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Biomolecular Chemistry
decks.description: Chemical structures and interactions underlying biological macromolecules.

outcomes.description: Explain folding, binding, hydration and membrane assembly through molecular interactions.
Relate protein, nucleic-acid, carbohydrate and lipid structures to chemical properties.
Classify biological hydrolysis, group-transfer, redox and energy-coupling reactions.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Organic Reaction Mechanisms
decks.description: Mechanistic reasoning across major organic reaction families.

outcomes.description: Explain substitution, elimination, addition, aromatic and carbonyl reaction mechanisms.
Analyze radical chains and introductory pericyclic reaction patterns.
Predict selectivity from conformation, orbital alignment and competing pathways.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Algorithm Design and Analysis
decks.description: General algorithmic strategies, correctness arguments and resource bounds.

outcomes.description: Derive asymptotic bounds and distinguish worst-case, average and amortized analysis.
Prove algorithm correctness using invariants, induction and exchange arguments.
Design greedy, divide-and-conquer, dynamic-programming and graph algorithms.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Database Systems
decks.description: Data models, query processing and transactional guarantees.

outcomes.description: Express queries and analyze indexing, joins and query optimization.
Design relational schemas using keys, dependencies and normalization.
Explain isolation, serializability, concurrency control and durable recovery.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Operating Systems
decks.description: Virtualization, protection and management of shared computing resources.

outcomes.description: Explain virtual memory, address translation, isolation and paging policies.
Analyze scheduling, processes, threads, synchronization and deadlock.
Analyze filesystems, persistence, caching and crash-recovery mechanisms.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Software Engineering
decks.description: Reliable software development through specifications, design and validation.

outcomes.description: Evaluate modular architectures, versioned changes, maintainability and delivery risks.
Translate stakeholder needs into explicit requirements, interfaces and acceptance criteria.
Design unit, integration, property-based and regression tests.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Complex Analysis
decks.description: Analytic functions, contour integration and singularities.

outcomes.description: Characterize holomorphic functions and apply analytic continuation principles.
Apply Cauchy's theorem, integral formulas and conformal mappings.
Use Laurent expansions, residues and argument principles to evaluate integrals.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamics
decks.description: Continuous-time models, solution methods and qualitative behavior.

outcomes.description: Solve standard first-order and linear higher-order differential equations.
Classify equilibria, phase portraits, bifurcations and local stability.
Analyze coupled linear and nonlinear differential-equation systems.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Measure Theory and Integration
decks.description: Measure-theoretic foundations for modern analysis and probability.

outcomes.description: Apply convergence theorems and distinguish convergence modes in function spaces.
Use Lebesgue integration, product integration and Radon-Nikodym derivatives.
Construct measures and reason about measurable functions and product spaces.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Number Theory and Finite Arithmetic
decks.description: Divisibility, modular structure and arithmetic used in coding and cryptography.

outcomes.description: Compute in finite fields and finite arithmetic groups.
Solve congruences using Euclidean algorithms and the Chinese remainder theorem.
Analyze prime factorization, arithmetic functions and quadratic residues.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Probability
decks.description: Random variables, uncertainty and probabilistic limit behavior.

outcomes.description: Apply conditional probability, independence, Bayes' rule and conditional expectation.
Model discrete and continuous random variables and compute expectations.
Use concentration bounds, laws of large numbers and central limit approximations.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: General Topology
decks.description: Topological spaces and invariant notions of continuity and compactness.

outcomes.description: Prove compactness results and distinguish topological convergence notions.
Analyze continuity, homeomorphisms, connectedness and separation properties.
Construct topologies, subspaces, products and quotient spaces.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Special Relativity
decks.description: Relativistic spacetime, kinematics and energy-momentum.

outcomes.description: Express physical laws covariantly and distinguish invariant from frame-dependent quantities.
Analyze relativistic energy, momentum, collisions and particle decays.
Use Lorentz transformations, spacetime intervals, four-vectors and causal structure.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Cell Biology
decks.description: Cellular organization, membrane processes and coordinated cellular behavior.

outcomes.description: Explain organelles, trafficking, cytoskeletal organization and cell-division machinery.
Analyze signal transduction, cell adhesion and cellular responses.
Explain membrane transport and ATP-coupled cellular processes.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Genetics
decks.description: Inheritance, recombination and relationships between genetic variation and phenotype.

outcomes.description: Analyze Mendelian, sex-linked, cytoplasmic and non-Mendelian inheritance patterns.
Infer linkage, recombination and genetic maps from inheritance data.
Relate mutations, chromosome changes and gene interactions to phenotypic variation.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Organic Synthesis and Strategy
decks.description: Retrosynthetic reasoning and selective construction of organic molecules.

outcomes.description: Develop retrosynthetic disconnections and identify plausible synthetic equivalents.
Plan chemoselective, regioselective and stereoselective transformations.
Compare synthetic routes by compatibility, step economy and material efficiency.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Search, Reasoning and Planning
decks.description: Symbolic artificial intelligence and goal-directed problem solving.

Analyze heuristic search, adversarial search and constraint-satisfaction methods.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Compiler Construction
decks.description: Translation from source languages to executable machine representations.

outcomes.description: Explain instruction selection, register allocation and runtime support.
Construct lexical, parsing, name-resolution and type-checking stages.
Use intermediate representations and dataflow analysis for sound optimizations.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Computational Complexity
decks.description: Resource-bounded computation, completeness and algorithmic limitations.

outcomes.description: Compare time, space and circuit complexity classes and hierarchy results.
Analyze randomized complexity, amplification and approximation guarantees.
Construct polynomial reductions and prove completeness or hardness results.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Computer Networks
decks.description: Layered communication, routing and reliable transport across networks.

outcomes.description: Explain addressing, framing, layering, naming and application protocols.
Analyze reliable transport, flow control and congestion-control mechanisms.
Compare routing algorithms and reason about latency, throughput and failures.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Formal Methods and Verification
decks.description: Machine-checkable reasoning about software and transition systems.

outcomes.description: Specify and prove program properties using Hoare logic and invariants.
Compare theorem proving, satisfiability solving and abstract interpretation.
Express temporal properties and analyze finite-state model-checking procedures.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Information Theory and Coding
decks.description: Quantitative limits of compression and reliable communication.

outcomes.description: Determine channel capacity and analyze error-correcting code constructions.
Analyze lossless coding and rate-distortion tradeoffs.
Compute entropy, mutual information and relative entropy and prove basic inequalities.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Numerical Analysis and Scientific Computing
decks.description: Reliable computational approximation of mathematical problems.

outcomes.description: Implement and assess interpolation, root-finding, quadrature and differential-equation solvers.
Distinguish conditioning, rounding, truncation error, stability and convergence.
Select direct and iterative methods for linear, least-squares and eigenvalue problems.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Algebraic Topology
decks.description: Algebraic invariants of spaces and continuous maps.

outcomes.description: Use algebraic invariants to distinguish spaces and establish topological obstructions.
Construct chain complexes and compute homology and basic cohomology.
Compute fundamental groups and analyze covering spaces and homotopy.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Differential Geometry
decks.description: Smooth manifolds, tensor calculus and curvature.

outcomes.description: Analyze metrics, connections, geodesics and curvature tensors.
Compute with differential forms, exterior derivatives and manifold integration.
Use charts, tangent spaces, smooth maps and tensor fields.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Functional Analysis
decks.description: Infinite-dimensional spaces and operators supporting advanced analysis and physics.

outcomes.description: Apply bounded-operator theorems and spectral results for compact or self-adjoint operators.
Analyze Banach and Hilbert spaces, dual spaces and completeness.
Use weak convergence, distributions and Sobolev-space formulations.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Optimization
decks.description: Convexity, constrained optimization and convergence of optimization methods.

outcomes.description: Analyze gradient, Newton, proximal and stochastic optimization methods.
Apply Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions and sensitivity analysis.
Recognize convex problems and establish optimality and duality properties.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Partial Differential Equations
decks.description: Boundary-value problems, transforms and well-posedness for continuum models.

outcomes.description: Classify PDEs and formulate appropriate initial and boundary conditions.
Analyze wave, diffusion and elliptic problems using energy and characteristic methods.
Apply Fourier expansions, transforms, separation of variables and Green functions.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Statistical Inference
decks.description: Estimation, uncertainty assessment and statistical modeling from data.

outcomes.description: Construct point estimates, confidence intervals and elementary Bayesian posterior summaries.
Fit and diagnose linear and generalized linear models.
Interpret hypothesis tests, power, multiplicity and resampling procedures.

decks.subject: mathematics
decks.title: Stochastic Processes
decks.description: Random evolution in discrete and continuous time.

outcomes.description: Analyze discrete and continuous-time Markov chains and hitting behavior.
Model Poisson processes, renewal processes and elementary queues.
Analyze stationary processes, autocorrelation and ergodic behavior.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Mechanics
decks.description: Variational formulations, phase-space dynamics and symmetry.

outcomes.description: Analyze Hamiltonian dynamics, Poisson brackets and canonical transformations.
Derive equations of motion using constraints and stationary-action principles.
Relate continuous symmetries to conserved quantities and reduced dynamics.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Electricity and Magnetism
decks.description: Electric and magnetic fields, circuits and Maxwell's equations.

outcomes.description: Analyze direct-current and alternating-current circuits with resistive and reactive elements.
Determine electrostatic and magnetostatic fields, potentials and forces.
Apply Maxwell's equations to induction, electromagnetic energy and wave propagation.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Oscillations and Waves
decks.description: Coupled oscillators, traveling waves and frequency-domain descriptions.

outcomes.description: Analyze damping, resonance, coupled oscillators and normal modes.
Represent signals and wave packets through Fourier modes and spectra.
Explain propagation, superposition, reflection, standing waves and dispersion.

decks.subject: physics
decks.title: Thermodynamics and Thermal Physics
decks.description: Macroscopic thermal laws, thermodynamic potentials and equilibrium.

outcomes.description: Apply temperature, heat, work, entropy and the thermodynamic laws.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Evolutionary Biology
decks.description: Evolutionary mechanisms, phylogenetic reasoning and adaptation.

outcomes.description: Analyze adaptation, life-history tradeoffs, speciation and macroevolutionary patterns.
Explain selection, drift, mutation, gene flow and reproductive isolation.
Interpret phylogenetic trees and evaluate homology and evolutionary evidence.

decks.subject: biology
decks.title: Molecular Biology and Gene Regulation
decks.description: Genome maintenance, gene expression and regulatory control.

outcomes.description: Analyze transcription, RNA processing, translation and RNA-mediated regulation.
Explain DNA replication, repair, recombination and chromosome organization.
Explain chromatin, transcriptional and post-transcriptional control across biological contexts.

decks.subject: chemistry

decks.description: Chemical measurement, calibration and equilibrium-based analysis.

outcomes.description: Design calibrations and assess uncertainty, detection limits and matrix effects.
Analyze titrimetric, gravimetric and equilibrium-based quantitative methods.

decks.subject: chemistry
decks.title: Chemical Thermodynamics
decks.description: Thermodynamic analysis of reacting systems, mixtures and phase behavior.

outcomes.description: Derive equilibrium relations and their temperature and pressure dependence.
Analyze solution nonideality, phase diagrams and multicomponent phase equilibria.
Calculate reaction free energies using standard states, activities and chemical potentials.

decks.subject: computer-science
decks.title: Cryptography

outcomes.description: Analyze public-key encryption, key agreement and digital signatures.
Evaluate cryptographic constructions using threat models, games and reductions.
Explain pseudorandomness, authenticated encryption, hashes and message authentication.

decks.subject: computer-science

outcomes.description: Analyze consensus protocols, fault tolerance and impossibility boundaries.

decks.subject: computer-science
